description: Free, open-source local PHP and Laravel development environment for Windows, an alternative to XAMPP and Laragon.
notes: Zefaro keeps your sites, settings and databases in %USERPROFILE%\.config\zefaro; 'scoop uninstall zefaro' leaves them there.
Update with 'scoop update zefaro'. 'Update now' inside Zefaro runs the regular installer, which adds a second copy outside Scoop.
Zefaro needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 and current Windows 10 already have.

script: # Only on uninstall, not on update: remove the PATH entry, start-with-Windows entry, *.test DNS rule and certificate authority Zefaro added.
